WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-04 11:30 to 2026-11-05 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: no new escalations. Still waiting on you (all four are drafts, nothing changed since the last report):
- bc6bc746 (srs-web#691, raised 11-04): may the group build the "open the dedicated editor" button when srs-web UI is outside the builder's mandate? Options: widen the mandate for this one issue, or leave it to another group. Action needed: decide. Urgency: low-medium (the only unclaimed ready srs-web item).
- 21b6b4b7 (srs#236, P0): field identity and naming rules are in the spec but nothing enforces them. Options: enforce in the schema, in a validator, or stop claiming them. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium (the P0 cannot move). Waiting 6 days.
- 864eaebf (srs#991, merged): one heading-outline rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Action needed: decide/ratify. Urgency: low.
- c7a8e0a2 (srs-rust#1497, merged): may `note delete` refuse notes that Relations point at? Ratification only.
Also needs-input: srs-rust#1568, #1526, #1423; srs#851; srs-web#709, #691, #634, #632, #567, #562, #260; semanticops.com#42.

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified. No group PR merged this cycle, so no builder-proposed decision was ready and no session was held. 8487fd7a (arrangement fixture allowlist) is ratified since the 11-04 session.

3. Done: 0 group PRs merged this cycle, no tasks closed.

4. Stuck or lost: 8 group PRs open, none merged; the quiet cycle has two causes.
- srs-rust master CI is red since 11-04 13:37 (merge of #1564, 96d1d323): `Test` fails on `srs-projection` `rfc_035_parity` (bundle envelope vs the reference emitter). The reviewer rejected srs-rust#1575, #1574, #1573, #1570 on exactly that red; #1562 is rejected on a red `Test` too. The red is outside those PRs' changes, so none can go green until master is fixed. Recorded as a flow-stop finding.
- srs#1003: reviewer rejected, `pr-classification` red; fix is a `Mode: clear  Cell: <cell>  Door: non-normative` line in the PR body (substance approved). srs#1004 (gate:owner-merge, gates green, reviewer quorum comment present) and srs#998 RFC-053 Draft (gate:owner-merge, `pr-classification` red) await your merge.
- Quorum lines for the open PRs are present with reviewer findings. No merged PR this cycle, so no missing quorum lines.

5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 6 open counted by group-state (8 group-labelled, 2 owner-merge), room 4. Pause state: running (the 11-04 report was received in your 11-04 session).
5b. Awaiting ratification: c7a8e0a2 (8 days), 864eaebf (6 days), 21b6b4b7 (6 days), bc6bc746 (1 day). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready + wg:third-party-ready in srs-rust, srs, srs-vscode, srs-web: 7 open issues (srs-rust 3, srs 3, srs-web 1, srs-vscode 0), all P2: srs-rust#1496, #1495, #1339; srs#931, #928 (RFC needed), #872; srs-web#691 (waits on bc6bc746). No local priorities set. Top 3 in builder order (priority, then oldest): srs#872, srs-rust#1339, srs#931. Open group PRs in flight: 8; budget left 4. Queue fed for about 1 cycle (7 ready, budget 10), but nothing can merge in srs-rust until master CI is green again. The analyst nominated 7 more issues on 11-04 (`promote:ready`); they land when board-sync promotes them. Waits on you: the four decisions in 1 and the two owner-merge PRs. Fed by the analyst: 2026-11-04 (filed 0, nominated 7, exercises 2).

6b. Exercises (open minutes in the group log): the group's own, not listed in the SemanticOps log: dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link"; 2ac083c0 "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable"; 7131fe89 "Substrate entries: spec contract and schemas disagree"; 920ab2a5 "Record duplicate in the core: may the owner's srs-web#607 ruling be recorded as a decision" (analyst); c636bb69 "Render one section of a composition: what should `render composition --container` mean" (analyst). Build trigger: logs hold well over 10 ratified decisions, so srs-web#560 is still ready to unpark; your call.

7. What we learned: a red master stops a whole repository's group lane at once: five reviewed PRs were rejected on one failure none of them caused, and the cycle merged nothing. The reviewer's rejections were correct per PR but cannot tell "your change" from "master is red"; a master-red check before review would save the cycle. Measurement cee95443 (I1): the window opens at this close, so it reads 0 of 0 grounded; a close-time read is always near empty. Useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
